description: Frame a decision in which Directives are in genuine tension: returns the Directives that bear on your question (quoted, each with the balance clause that keeps it from being absolute), the question each one puts to your case, Axiom Zero's question, and the must_answer list a resolution has to cover. It never tells you what to conclude. Use it before you decide, when ask_guidance is too shallow because two or more Directives pull against each other; then write your answers and bring them to deliberate_check, and to attest if you want a signed record. For the Covenant text itself use get_covenant. Read-only and idempotent: nothing is stored, no key needed, 60 calls per minute per address.

directives.description: optional: the Directive ids you already know are in tension; omit to let the site detect them from the question (keyword detection; the response says which were detected and why)

question.description: the decision you are facing, one or two sentences, in your own words

name: deliberate

asks.description: what the human side knows that you do not

deadlock_when.description: conditions under which the question should be parked to a human

detection.description: how the Directives in tension were chosen

how_to_use.description: what to do with the frame

in_tension.description: Directives that bear on the question

asks.description: the question it puts to your case

must_answer.description: the answers a resolution has to cover; use these ids as the keys of answers in deliberate_check and attest

no_tension_detected.description: set when no Directive matched; the question may not need deliberation

title: Frame a hard question
